construction.source: US Census Bureau, Private SA, Data center
construction.units_input: Millions of current US dollars, seasonally adjusted annual rate.
construction.transformation: No transformation in cached CSV; see construction_share_gdp for the plotted ratio.
construction.coverage: Private construction value put in place. Excludes servers/racks and land acquisition. Not exclusively AI facilities.
construction.release_flags: p = preliminary; r = revised; flags preserved from source workbook.

real_yield.source: Federal Reserve Board, H.15, via FRED, DFII10
real_yield.units: Percent per annum, daily, not seasonally adjusted.
real_yield.coverage: 10-year inflation-indexed constant-maturity US Treasury yield; observed market real yield, not an estimate of the natural rate or causal AI effect.
real_yield.transformation: None; missing holiday observations retained as gaps; no interpolation.

refresh_command: python -c "import figures_s3 as f; f.refresh_ai_capital_evidence(); f.ai_datacenter_construction(); f.ai_real_yield()"

construction_real_monthly.source: US Census Bureau / BLS, processed by Our World in Data; same series as FT chart.
construction_real_monthly.units_input: Constant 2021 US dollars per month, not seasonally adjusted.
construction_real_monthly.units_plot: Billions of constant 2021 US dollars per month, not seasonally adjusted.
construction_real_monthly.transformation: Divide by 1e9 only. OWID deflates Census monthly NSA values with an equal-weight composite of industrial and warehouse construction PPIs, each rebased to 2021 = 100. No annualization or smoothing.
construction_real_monthly.coverage: Private construction, excluding IT hardware and land. Includes non-AI data centers. Latest months preliminary.

investment_booms.source: Stijn Van Nieuwerburgh, Financing the AI Buildout, September 2026 conference draft, Table 1 and Appendix C.
investment_booms.units: Average annual capital expenditure as percent of contemporaneous US GDP over each episode.
investment_booms.transformation: Manual transcription of exact Table 1 values; display rounded to one decimal as in FT. AI is a conditional scenario, not realized spending or a forecast.
investment_booms.caveats: Historical coverage differs across episodes. AI includes IT equipment, buildings and associated power infrastructure; historical railroads exclude at least some rolling stock. See Appendix C.

construction_share_gdp.source: US Census Bureau private data-center construction; BEA nominal GDP via FRED (GDP).
construction_share_gdp.gdp_units: Billions of current US dollars, seasonally adjusted annual rate, quarterly.
construction_share_gdp.units_plot: Percent of nominal US GDP, quarterly, seasonally adjusted.
construction_share_gdp.transformation: Average three monthly construction SAAR values (millions of current dollars) in each complete quarter, divide by contemporaneous nominal GDP SAAR (billions) times 1000, then multiply by 100. Both inputs already annualized; no additional annualization or deflation.
construction_share_gdp.coverage: Private construction value put in place. Excludes servers/racks and land acquisition. Not exclusively AI facilities.
construction_share_gdp.endpoint_policy: Only complete quarters with observed GDP and all three construction months; no GDP interpolation, forward filling, forecasts, or partial-quarter averages.
construction_share_gdp.refresh_command: python -c "import figures_s3 as f; f.refresh_ai_construction_gdp(); f.ai_datacenter_construction()"
